scope: Proposition 6.2 (Algebraization of an isolated analytic germ) of the manuscript “A singular normal affine surface with free tangent sheaf” (preprints/A-singular-normal-affine-surface-with-free-tangent-sheaf-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 048 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 48b1a74d3131e97b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, x) be a normal complex analytic germ of dimension d ≥ 1, smooth away from x, and suppose that its holomorphic tangent module is free of rank d. There exist a finitely generated normal integral C-algebra A and a maximal ideal p ⊂ A such that dim A = d, A/p = C, Âp ≃ ˆ OX,x, DerC(A) ≃ Ad . The affine variety Spec A can be chosen smooth away from p. If x is singular, Ap is nonregular.
